shared.tagline.en: Know the wait before you walk in.
shared.tagline.text: Alamin ang oras ng paghihintay bago ka pumasok.

shared.footer.copyright.en: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independent and not affiliated with Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat.
shared.footer.copyright.text: © 2026 PickupRadar. Independiyente at hindi konektado sa Uber Eats, Deliveroo o Just Eat.

shared.scale.estimate.en: No recent reports? PickupRadar may show {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}:
shared.scale.estimate.text: Walang bagong ulat? Maaaring magpakita ang PickupRadar ng {likelyFast} o {likelySlow}:

home.meta.title.en: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): pickup wait times for delivery drivers in the UK
home.meta.title.text: PickupRadar (Pickup Radar): oras ng paghihintay sa pickup para sa mga driver sa United Kingdom

home.meta.description.en: See how long drivers wait at restaurants and shops before you go in. For Uber Eats, Deliveroo and Just Eat drivers in the UK. No sign-up needed.
home.meta.description.text: Tingnan kung gaano katagal naghihintay ang mga driver sa mga restaurant at tindahan bago ka pumasok. Para sa mga driver ng Uber Eats, Deliveroo at Just Eat sa United Kingdom. Walang sign-up.

home.meta.imageAlt.en: PickupRadar. Know the wait before you walk in.
home.meta.imageAlt.text: PickupRadar. Alamin ang oras ng paghihintay bago ka pumasok.

home.hero.lede.en: Do you deliver for Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat? See recent pickup waits at restaurants and shops. Avoid long waits. Tap {reportWait} and earn {radarPoints}. No sign-up needed.
home.hero.lede.text: Nagde-deliver ka para sa Uber Eats, Deliveroo o Just Eat? Tingnan ang pinakabagong oras ng paghihintay sa mga pickup point na restaurant at tindahan. Iwasan ang mahabang paghihintay. I-tap ang {reportWait} at kumita ng {radarPoints}. Walang sign-up.

home.hero.cities.en: Now in Milton Keynes. London is next.
home.hero.cities.text: Ngayon sa Milton Keynes. Susunod ang London.

home.hero.apps.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon.
home.hero.apps.text: Malapit nang dumating ang mga app para sa iPhone at Android.

home.example.aria.en: Example PickupRadar Home screen with the {nearby} tab open, showing pickup points coloured by their wait
home.example.aria.text: Halimbawang home screen ng PickupRadar na bukas ang tab na {nearby}. May kulay ang mga pickup point ayon sa oras ng paghihintay

home.example.banner.en: Example screen: sample waits, not live driver reports
home.example.banner.text: Halimbawang screen: halimbawang oras ng paghihintay, hindi live na ulat ng driver

home.example.caption.en: Example screen. These are sample wait times, not live reports. {live} with real data.
home.example.caption.text: Halimbawang screen. Halimbawang oras ng paghihintay ito, hindi live na ulat. {live} gamit ang totoong data.

home.try.tab.en: {lead} Use {nearby} to find pickup points close to you when location is on. Use {fast} and {slow} to check waits and estimates.
home.try.tab.text: {lead} Gamitin ang {nearby} para hanapin ang mga pickup point malapit sa iyo kapag naka-on ang lokasyon. Gamitin ang {fast} at {slow} para tingnan ang mga oras ng paghihintay at tantiya.

home.try.search.en: {lead} Try a name, area or postcode, like KFC or Bletchley.
home.try.search.text: {lead} Subukan ang pangalan, lugar o postcode, gaya ng KFC o Bletchley.

home.try.open.en: {lead} The {reportWait} screen opens. Choose a wait time. Nothing is sent.
home.try.open.text: {lead} Bubukas ang screen na {reportWait}. Pumili ng oras ng paghihintay. Walang ipapadala.

home.signals.title.en: What you can see before you go in

home.signals.intro.en: You see the same labels in the app. Drivers report them, not the delivery apps.
home.signals.intro.text: Parehong label ang makikita mo sa app. Mga driver ang nag-uulat nito, hindi ang delivery app.

home.signals.current.body.en: Drivers choose a wait time. You see the current wait and how many drivers reported it in the last 2 hours.
home.signals.current.body.text: Pinipili ng mga driver ang oras ng paghihintay. Makikita mo ang kasalukuyang oras ng paghihintay at kung ilang driver ang nag-ulat nito sa nakalipas na 2 oras.

home.signals.likely.body.en: Shown only when there are no recent reports. These are estimates, not live reports.
home.signals.likely.body.text: Ipinapakita lang kapag walang bagong ulat. Tantiya ito, hindi live na ulat.

home.signals.closed.body.en: Drivers tap {reportProblem} to report this. You see their report before you drive there.
home.signals.closed.body.text: Ini-tap ng mga driver ang {reportProblem} para iulat ito. Makikita mo ang ulat bago ka magmaneho papunta roon.

home.how.intro.en: Three easy steps. Reporting takes a few seconds.
home.how.intro.text: Tatlong madaling hakbang. Ilang segundo lang ang pag-uulat.

home.how.step1.body.en: No password. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You don't need to sign up.
home.how.step1.body.text: Walang password. Awtomatikong binibigyan ka ng app ng Radar profile. Hindi mo kailangang mag-sign up.

home.how.step2.body.en: Find the pickup point. See the current wait, or {likelyFast} or {likelySlow} if there are no recent reports.
home.how.step2.body.text: Hanapin ang pickup point. Tingnan ang kasalukuyang oras ng paghihintay, o ang {likelyFast} o {likelySlow} kung walang bagong ulat.

home.how.step3.title.text: Iulat ang iyong oras ng paghihintay

home.how.step3.body.en: After you collect the order, tap {reportWait}. It takes seconds. Your report helps other drivers, and you earn {radarPoints}.
home.how.step3.body.text: Pagkatapos kunin ang order, i-tap ang {reportWait}. Ilang segundo lang. Nakakatulong ang ulat mo sa ibang driver, at kumikita ka ng {radarPoints}.

home.points.noteSoon.text: Malapit nang dumating ang mga reward.

home.points.note.text: {soon} Hindi mo pa maaaring tubusin ang {radarPoints}.

home.points.neededHelp.en: An eligible pickup point near you with no recent wait and no {likelyFast} or {likelySlow}. You earn 15 RP for the report instead of 10.
home.points.neededHelp.text: Isang kwalipikadong pickup point malapit sa iyo, walang bagong oras ng paghihintay, at walang {likelyFast} o {likelySlow}. Makakakuha ka ng 15 RP para sa ulat na iyon, sa halip na 10.

home.cities.body.en: These are the UK cities in the app. Can't find your city? Request it in the app. Or tap {notify} on a {comingSoon} city. We'll email you when it's live.
home.cities.body.text: Ito ang mga lungsod sa United Kingdom sa app. Hindi mo makita ang lungsod mo? I-request ito sa app. O i-tap ang {notify} sa lungsod na {comingSoon}. Mag-e-email kami kapag live na ito.

home.trust.title.en: Not part of any delivery app
home.trust.title.text: Hindi bahagi ng anumang delivery app

home.trust.body.en: PickupRadar is independent. It is not part of Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or any other delivery app. It never uses your accounts with them.
home.trust.body.text: Independiyente ang PickupRadar. Hindi ito bahagi ng Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat o anumang ibang delivery app. Hindi nito ginagamit ang account mo doon.

home.trust.login.en: {lead} We never ask for your Uber Eats, Deliveroo or Just Eat username or password.
home.trust.login.text: {lead} Hindi kami humihingi ng username o password sa Uber Eats, Deliveroo o Just Eat.

home.trust.detailsLead.text: Walang detalye ng customer o order.

home.trust.details.en: {lead} No names, addresses or order numbers.
home.trust.details.text: {lead} Walang pangalan, address o numero ng order.

home.faq.account.a.en: No. The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You can report waits straight away. To protect your {radarPoints}, add your email later. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
home.faq.account.a.text: Hindi. Awtomatikong binibigyan ka ng app ng Radar profile. Maaari kang mag-ulat ng oras ng paghihintay agad. Para protektahan ang {radarPoints}, magdagdag ng email mamaya. Walang password. Nagpapadala ang app ng 6-digit na code sa email.

home.faq.download.q.en: When can I download the app?

home.faq.download.a.en: The iPhone and Android apps are coming soon. For now, the {preview} shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits.
home.faq.download.a.text: Malapit nang dumating ang mga app para sa iPhone at Android. Sa ngayon, ipinapakita ng {preview} ang totoong pickup point at oras ng paghihintay sa Milton Keynes.

home.faq.track.q.text: Tinitrack ba nito ang lokasyon ko?

home.faq.track.a.en: No background tracking. The app uses your location while you use it, to show nearby pickup points and check you are at a pickup point when reporting. The website asks for location only when you choose to use it. Read the {privacy} for more.
home.faq.track.a.text: Walang background tracking. Ginagamit ng app ang lokasyon mo habang ginagamit mo ito, para ipakita ang malalapit na pickup point at tingnan na nasa pickup point ka habang nag-uulat. Humihingi lang ang site ng lokasyon kapag pinili mong gamitin ito. Basahin ang {privacy} para sa higit pa.

app.meta.title.text: Live na preview ng app — PickupRadar

app.meta.description.en: Try the PickupRadar app with real Milton Keynes data. Look around, search for pickup points and see the report screen.
app.meta.description.text: Subukan ang app ng PickupRadar gamit ang totoong data ng Milton Keynes. Maglibot, maghanap ng pickup point at tingnan ang screen ng ulat.

app.hero.lede.en: This is PickupRadar with real Milton Keynes data. Look around. Search for a pickup point and open it. Nothing you tap here is sent. You can only report in the mobile app.
app.hero.lede.text: Ito ang PickupRadar gamit ang totoong data ng Milton Keynes. Maglibot. Maghanap ng pickup point at buksan ito. Walang ipinapadala sa anumang i-tap mo dito. Sa phone app ka lang maaaring mag-ulat.

app.preview.aria.en: Full PickupRadar app preview with real Milton Keynes data
app.preview.aria.text: Buong preview ng app ng PickupRadar gamit ang totoong data ng Milton Keynes

support.meta.description.en: Get help with PickupRadar: contact support, report a pickup point problem, and find answers about your Radar profile, {radarPoints} and deleting your account.
support.meta.description.text: Tulong sa PickupRadar: makipag-ugnayan sa suporta, mag-ulat ng problema sa pickup point, at humanap ng sagot tungkol sa Radar profile, {radarPoints} at pag-delete ng account.

support.hero.lede.en: Need help? Email us about the app, a pickup point, your {radarPoints} or your privacy.
support.hero.lede.text: Kailangan ng tulong? Mag-email tungkol sa app, pickup point, {radarPoints} o privacy mo.

support.contact.body.en: Email us for help, ideas, pickup point problems or privacy questions:
support.contact.body.text: Mag-email para sa tulong, ideya, problema sa pickup point o tanong sa privacy:

support.address.title.text: Address para sa liham ng negosyo

support.address.note.en: For letters only. Email is the fastest way to reach us.
support.address.note.text: Para sa liham lang. Ang email ang pinakamabilis na paraan para makipag-ugnayan sa amin.

support.include.body.en: If you report a problem, please tell us:
support.include.body.text: Kung nag-uulat ka ng problema, sabihin sa amin:

support.include.area.en: The area or postcode, if you know it
support.include.area.text: Lugar o postcode, kung alam mo

support.include.phone.en: Your phone model, if the app has a problem
support.include.phone.text: Modelo ng telepono mo, kung problema sa app

support.topics.profile.body.en: The app gives you a Radar profile automatically. You do not need to log in to use PickupRadar or earn {radarPoints}. Adding your email is optional. It protects your {radarPoints} if you change or reset your phone. No password needed. The app emails you a 6-digit code.
support.topics.profile.body.text: Awtomatikong binibigyan ka ng app ng Radar profile. Hindi mo kailangang mag-sign in para gamitin ang PickupRadar o kumita ng {radarPoints}. Opsyonal ang pagdagdag ng email. Pinoprotektahan nito ang {radarPoints} kung magpapalit o magre-reset ka ng telepono. Walang password. Nagpapadala ang app ng 6-digit na code sa email.

support.topics.points.body.en: You earn {radarPoints} for valid wait reports ({waitRp}, or {neededRp} when it says {reportNeeded}), a first report bonus ({firstRp}) and pickup points we approve ({approvedRp}). You can invite a driver from {profile}. You both need protected Radar accounts (add your email). Your friend enters your code before their first valid wait report. When your friend makes 3 valid wait reports, on at least 2 different days (UTC time), at 2 different pickup points, you each earn {referralRp}. {rewards} You can't redeem {radarPoints} yet.
support.topics.points.body.text: Kumikita ka ng {radarPoints} para sa valid na ulat ng oras ng paghihintay ({waitRp}, o {neededRp} kapag nakasulat ang {reportNeeded}), bonus sa unang ulat ({firstRp}) at pickup point na inaprubahan namin ({approvedRp}). Maaari kang mag-imbita ng driver mula sa {profile}. Pareho kayong kailangan ng protektadong Radar account (magdagdag ng email). Inilalagay ng kaibigan mo ang code mo bago ang unang valid na ulat ng oras ng paghihintay. Kapag gumawa ang kaibigan mo ng 3 valid na ulat ng oras ng paghihintay, sa hindi bababa sa 2 magkaibang araw (oras ng UTC), sa 2 magkaibang pickup point, makakakuha kayo ng tig-{referralRp}. {rewards} Hindi mo pa maaaring tubusin ang {radarPoints}.

support.topics.messages.body.en: {profile} has {messages}: announcements, alerts and personal messages for your city or Radar profile. Old or removed messages may no longer appear.
support.topics.messages.body.text: May {messages} ang {profile}: anunsyo, alerto at personal na mensahe para sa lungsod mo o Radar profile. Maaaring hindi na lumabas ang lumang mensahe o ang inalis.

support.topics.delete.body.en: Delete your account in the app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. Or email {email}. If you did not add an email, the app shows {deleteProfile} instead. See the {page} page for the steps.
support.topics.delete.body.text: I-delete ang account sa app: {profile} → {deleteAccount}. O mag-email sa {email}. Kung hindi ka nagdagdag ng email, ipinapakita ng app ang {deleteProfile}. Tingnan ang pahina ng {page} para sa mga hakbang.

support.topics.missing.body.en: Is a pickup point missing? Tap {suggest} in the app. Is one wrong? Tap {reportProblem}. Or email us and we will check it.
support.topics.missing.body.text: Wala ang pickup point? I-tap ang {suggest} sa app. May mali? I-tap ang {reportProblem}. O mag-email sa amin at titingnan namin.

support.topics.delivery.body.en: PickupRadar does not connect to your Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat or other delivery app accounts. We never ask for your delivery app logins, passwords, account details, customer details or order details. Drivers only share pickup reports, like wait times and pickup point problems.
support.topics.delivery.body.text: Hindi konektado ang PickupRadar sa account mo sa Uber Eats, Deliveroo, Just Eat o anumang ibang delivery app. Hindi kami humihingi ng login, password, detalye ng account, detalye ng customer o detalye ng order. Mga ulat ng pickup lang ang ibinabahagi ng mga driver, gaya ng oras ng paghihintay at problema sa pickup point.

support.closer.title.en: Try PickupRadar before the app launches.
support.closer.title.text: Subukan ang PickupRadar bago ilunsad ang app.

support.closer.body.en: The live preview shows real Milton Keynes pickup points and waits. Reporting and {radarPoints} are only in the mobile app.
support.closer.body.text: Ipinapakita ng live na preview ang totoong pickup point at oras ng paghihintay sa Milton Keynes. Ang pag-uulat at {radarPoints} ay nasa phone app lang.

notfound.meta.description.en: That page is not on the PickupRadar website.
notfound.meta.description.text: Wala ang pahinang iyon sa site ng PickupRadar.

notfound.title.en: This page is off the radar.
notfound.title.text: Wala sa radar ang pahinang ito.

notfound.body.en: That address isn't on the PickupRadar website. These pages are:
notfound.body.text: Wala ang address na iyon sa site ng PickupRadar. Nandito ang mga pahinang ito:

privacy.toc.aria.text: Mga seksyon ng patakaran sa privacy

privacy.notice.en: The summary and section headings are translated. The full privacy policy is in English, which is the official version.
privacy.notice.text: Isinalin ang buod at mga pamagat ng seksyon. Nasa Ingles ang buong patakaran sa privacy, at ang bersyong Ingles ang opisyal na bersyon.

privacy.h.collect.en: Information we collect and how we use it
privacy.h.collect.text: Anong impormasyon ang kinokolekta namin at paano namin ito ginagamit

privacy.h.legalBases.text: Ang aming mga legal na batayan (UK)

privacy.h.retention.text: Gaano katagal namin itinatago ang impormasyon

privacy.h.rights.text: Ang iyong mga pagpipilian at karapatan

privacy.sum.what.en: PickupRadar helps delivery drivers see and report pickup wait times and venue problems.
privacy.sum.what.text: Tinutulungan ng PickupRadar ang mga delivery driver na makita at i-report ang oras ng paghihintay sa pickup at mga problema sa venue.

privacy.sum.account.en: You can browse without creating an account. The app creates an anonymous Radar profile for your phone, and an email account is optional.
privacy.sum.account.text: Puwede kang mag-browse nang walang account. Gumagawa ang app ng anonymous na Radar profile para sa iyong phone, at opsyonal ang email account.

privacy.sum.location.en: If you allow location, the app uses it while you are using it: to sort nearby pickup points, detect your city and check that you are at a venue when you submit a live report. We do not save your location with your reports.
privacy.sum.location.text: Kung papayagan mo ang lokasyon, ginagamit lang ito ng app habang ginagamit mo ito: para ayusin ang mga kalapit na pickup spot, alamin ang iyong lungsod, at tiyaking nasa venue ka kapag nagpapadala ng live na report. Hindi namin sine-save ang iyong lokasyon kasama ng iyong mga report.

privacy.sum.saved.en: Your saved pickup points stay on your phone.
privacy.sum.saved.text: Nananatili sa iyong phone ang mga na-save mong pickup spot.

privacy.sum.noSale.en: We do not sell your personal information and the app contains no advertising or analytics trackers.
privacy.sum.noSale.text: Hindi namin ibinebenta ang iyong personal na impormasyon, at walang advertising o analytics tracker ang app.

privacy.sum.delete.en: You can delete your Radar profile or account in the app, or ask us by email. See {link}.
privacy.sum.delete.text: Puwede mong i-delete ang iyong Radar profile o account sa app, o i-email kami para gawin ito. Tingnan ang {link}.

delete.meta.title.en: Delete your account or data — PickupRadar
delete.meta.title.text: I-delete ang iyong account o data — PickupRadar

delete.meta.description.en: How to delete your PickupRadar account, Radar profile and associated data, including without the app.
delete.meta.description.text: Paano i-delete ang iyong PickupRadar account, Radar profile at kaugnay na data, kahit wala ang app.

delete.toc.aria.text: Mga seksyon sa pag-delete ng account

delete.h1.text: I-delete ang iyong account o data

delete.lead.en: This page explains how to delete your PickupRadar account, your Radar profile and the data linked to them, including if you no longer have the app. PickupRadar is developed by Hamza Khan.
delete.lead.text: Ipinapaliwanag ng pahinang ito kung paano i-delete ang iyong PickupRadar account, Radar profile at ang data na naka-link sa mga ito, kahit wala ka nang app. Ang PickupRadar ay ginawa ni Hamza Khan.

delete.app.step2.en: Tap {profile} at the bottom of the Home screen.
delete.app.step2.text: I-tap ang {profile} sa ibaba ng home screen.

delete.app.step3.en: Scroll down and tap {deleteAccount} if you protected your RadarPoints with your email, or {deleteProfile} if you did not.
delete.app.step3.text: Mag-scroll pababa at i-tap ang {deleteAccount} kung pinrotektahan mo ang iyong RadarPoints gamit ang email, o {deleteProfile} kung hindi.

delete.app.after.en: Deletion starts straight away. Afterwards, the app starts a new anonymous Radar profile on your phone.
delete.app.after.text: Agad na magsisimula ang pag-delete. Pagkatapos, magsisimula ang app ng bagong anonymous na Radar profile sa iyong phone.

delete.email.title.en: Ask us to delete your email account
delete.email.title.text: Hilingin sa amin na i-delete ang iyong email account

delete.email.intro.en: If you protected your RadarPoints with your email address and cannot use the app:
delete.email.intro.text: Kung pinrotektahan mo ang iyong RadarPoints gamit ang email address at hindi mo magamit ang app:

delete.email.step1.text: Mag-email sa {email} {from}, na may subject na “{subject}”.

delete.email.from.en: from the email address on your PickupRadar account
delete.email.from.text: mula sa email address ng iyong PickupRadar account

delete.email.step2.en: We will reply to that address to confirm the request before deleting anything.
delete.email.step2.text: Sasagot kami sa address na iyon para kumpirmahin ang kahilingan bago kami mag-delete ng anuman.

delete.email.other.en: If you write from a different address, we will need to confirm that you control the account’s email address. We will never ask for a password or for a sign-in code. Do not send us your code.
delete.email.other.text: Kung susulat ka mula sa ibang address, kailangan naming kumpirmahing ikaw ang may kontrol sa email address ng account. Hindi kami kailanman hihingi ng password o sign-in code. Huwag ipadala sa amin ang iyong code.

delete.anon.p1.en: If you never added an email address, your Radar profile is linked only to a random ID stored in the app on your phone. The easiest way to delete it is in the app, using the steps above.
delete.anon.p1.text: Kung hindi ka kailanman nagdagdag ng email address, naka-link lang ang iyong Radar profile sa isang random na ID na naka-save sa app sa iyong phone. Ang pinakamadaling paraan para i-delete ito ay sa app, gamit ang mga hakbang sa itaas.

delete.anon.p2.en: Deleting the app removes that ID from your phone, but it does {not} delete the records on our servers.
delete.anon.p2.text: Ang pag-delete ng app ay nag-aalis ng ID na iyon sa iyong phone, pero {not} ang mga record sa aming mga server.

delete.anon.p3.en: Ownership of an anonymous profile can only be proven from the phone it was created on, using the random ID and secret code stored in the app. Details such as a Radar name, a city or the dates you used the app can’t prove that a profile is yours, because other people could know them. So if you no longer have the app, we may not be able to delete an anonymous profile. You can still email {email} and we will explain what we can do.
delete.anon.p3.text: Mapapatunayan lang ang pagmamay-ari ng anonymous na profile mula sa phone na gumawa nito, gamit ang random na ID at secret code na naka-save sa app. Hindi napapatunayan ng mga detalye gaya ng Radar name, lungsod o mga petsa ng paggamit mo ng app na sa iyo ang profile, dahil puwede rin itong malaman ng iba. Kaya kung wala ka nang app, maaaring hindi namin ma-delete ang anonymous na profile. Puwede ka pa ring mag-email sa {email} at ipapaliwanag namin kung ano ang magagawa namin.

delete.alerts.title.text: Mga email ng alerto sa paglulunsad sa lungsod

delete.alerts.body.en: You can withdraw a launch alert in the app, or email us from the address you signed up with and we will delete the sign-ups for that address. Launch-alert emails are also deleted automatically, as explained in our {privacy}.
delete.alerts.body.text: Puwede mong bawiin ang alerto sa paglulunsad sa app, o i-email kami mula sa address na ginamit mo sa pag-sign up at ide-delete namin ang mga sign-up para sa address na iyon. Awtomatiko ring dine-delete ang mga email ng alerto sa paglulunsad, gaya ng ipinapaliwanag ng aming {privacy}.

delete.deleted.profile.en: Your Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints and contribution history
delete.deleted.profile.text: Ang iyong Radar profile, Radar name, RadarPoints at kasaysayan ng kontribusyon

delete.deleted.email.en: Your email sign-in, if you had an email account
delete.deleted.email.text: Ang iyong email sign-in, kung may email account ka

delete.deleted.links.en: The links between your phone’s device ID and your profile
delete.deleted.links.text: Mga link sa pagitan ng device ID ng iyong phone at ng iyong profile

delete.deleted.referrals.en: Your referral codes, and your read or dismissed status for in-app messages
delete.deleted.referrals.text: Ang iyong mga referral code, at ang status na nabasa o isinara ng mga mensahe sa app

delete.deleted.alerts.en: City launch alert sign-ups linked to your profile or phone
delete.deleted.alerts.text: Mga sign-up sa alerto sa paglulunsad sa lungsod na naka-link sa iyong profile o phone

delete.deleted.notes.en: Notes on the problem reports, status reports and venue suggestions linked to your profile
delete.deleted.notes.text: Mga tala sa mga report ng problema, status report at mungkahing venue na naka-link sa iyong profile

delete.kept.reports.en: {lead}, such as wait times, venue status reports and tags, and venue suggestions: the device ID on the records linked to your profile is replaced with a random value, so they are no longer connected to your profile in our database. They still contain details such as the venue and time, so they are de-identified rather than fully anonymous. They may be kept so they can still help other drivers.
delete.kept.reports.text: {lead}, gaya ng oras ng paghihintay, status report at tag ng venue, at mga mungkahing venue: pinapalitan ng random na value ang device ID sa mga record na naka-link sa iyong profile, kaya sa aming database ay hindi na naka-link ang mga ito sa iyong profile. Naglalaman pa rin ang mga ito ng mga detalye gaya ng venue at oras, kaya de-identified ang mga ito, hindi ganap na anonymous. Maaaring itago ang mga ito para patuloy na makatulong sa ibang driver.
